title: Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse
director: Bob Persichetti, Peter Ramsey, Rodney Rothman
favouriteScene: The Leap of Faith sequence: inverted camera diving upward into the Brooklyn skyline.
favouritePerformance: Shameik Moore as Miles Morales & Jake Johnson as Peter B. Parker
personalReflections: Revolutionized visual animation by fusing comic-book halftones with 3D space, anchored by profound human emotion and the vulnerability of becoming oneself.
